Haa, aah, ahh―――

#C236196003KARNAAA#CDEF!!

…which leaves one person.
The only person left is #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, dazed.

A-ah…
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF―――
I lock with her startled and anticipatory gaze.

…sorry.

……hehehehehe…
Here you are… So at last you came, eh?

Yes. It's all coming together.
The carefully calculated…

Me?
……………why?

Compulsive Liar

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF's mind may seem weak enough to beat easily,

Loneliness
I say―――

Kyaaaa……!

Lonely, really…
Lonely… that's like… uugh…
*sob*… waaaaahhhh!
…I can't stand this anymore.

If I identify it, then I can finally

You can join stuff together, but that doesn't

Gwaaaaaaah!

Haa, kgh…!
Ahh… ahh, ah―――
Haa, ah…!

HYOOWWW!?
Awawa! Sorry, sorry, MY BAD!

B-but what else was I supposed to do!?

I'm just a NEET!

I don't think that counts as a NEET…
Awawa! Sorrysorry! I'm sure there are
NEETs like that out there!

But that's not what I am!
Before I even realized it, I turned into this!
No one will love someone like me!

Hyow…!? No!
Don't go shoving some rod in between…!

Haa… haa… haa…
Ugh… Getting yelled at, getting complimented―
I feel like a mess…

But… I can tell that you really are
mad at me, frustrated with me…
…#C236196003Jinako#CDEF sounds more serious than she has been.
I say―――

Hic… uuuggghhh…!
You don't get it… You completely, absolutely,
haven't the slightest clue!

Ah…!
Haa―――It, tingles―――
It hurts, but it feels, good―――

Don't be, so hard, on myself―――
That's it?
Is that, okay―――?

…yeah.
I think #C236196003Jinako#CDEF forgot that one, simple thing.

HYAAAWWAAAA!

#C080080080…she sounded a little desperate at the end there,

I suppose you're #C236196003Launcher#CDEF.

I also feel disappointed.
It pains me greatly to battle it out with
one when there is no need.

Hmph. There's no other Servant around
worth fighting less.

No hostility, yet your guard is steel and you
shoulder no pride. There's this king, another
goldie, that I want to have learn from you.

Oh, we haven't met in quite a while.
Your Master declared she didn't need little old
you, yet you still faithfully follow her?

I've come for your head, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF.
Time to make good on what you committed to.

Even more so for the golden Heroic Spirit.
Though I had wished to draw my chariot and clash
against you over the sunset tumult of war…

This, too, is fate. If you'll think of your lord
and retreat with dignity, then fine. If you'll
protect your lord until the end, that's fine.

How magnificent, rose emperor.
I'm certain many of your people lauded your
lifestyle, but I see only tragedy.

But listen, Heroic Spirit of charity.
Is this battle really necessary? Isn't there
someone ELSE that needs admonishing?

Keep to your own affairs, don't speak of mine.
You have a bad habit of meddling with those you
see as good―be they friend or foe, #C236196003Archer#CDEF.

I'll just say this: your over-protectiveness is
much too genuine. One can believe in another's
future, but to some, that's simply a burden.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is one of those people.
Don't you understand that the more you try to
do right, the more you pressure your Master?

You're the one lacking prudence.
Also, I'm not a just Heroic Spirit,
and I never expected anything from #C236196003Jinako#CDEF.

Or perhaps you'll plead for your life? Go ahead.
I'm generous and am especially compassionate
towards those with the value of gold.

Will it be your armor? Lance? Head?
I had told you to sacrifice any one to me.
The conditions haven't changed, see?

You're voraciously insatiable.
With such a fortune as yours, you yet still
desire more, new treasure?

…well, I understand how you feel.
As you know, this head of mine isn't even
worth a pittance.

Anything and everything you do has to be
on stage, so much so that your life is
filled with despair and sorrow.

You're the one who's admonishing the wrong
person. You consider the order "justice" to be
good, yet you seek to be an ally of the weak.

That probably goes for you, too.
Keeping close to your Master is what you deem
fine; not protecting or guiding them.

Even if that results in nothing for you,
you won't go and change that outcome out of
selfishness.

This might not be worth it to you
unless you take my armor or my lance――
But you'll have to give up on those.

I already pledged my armor away.
That said, I also need this lance
to fulfill my promise to you.

I shall lower the curtains on you, #C236196003Saber#CDEF.
Once the leading actor disappears,
the stage will go with them.

Do you realize the contradiction, weak one?
If you can't kill your emotions,
then at least stop championing justice.

Although, several of your desires do ooze
out when you speak. Which means you're truly a
pure fox, who sacrifices for her Master.

So in the end, all that remains is my head.
So you'll have to settle with taking it.
――Of course, that's only if you can.

#C236196003Karna#CDEF stands firm like the stern,
chief butler of a mansion.
He regards us as enemies, yet
maintains his courtesy.
His serenity overwhelmingly intimidates us back.

…#C236196003Jinako#CDEF herself is well aware that she
mustn't continue hiding any longer.

The reality is that your Master became strong
over a short time. I'm not speaking of martial
strength, but mental fortitude.

#[His][Her]# unparalleled, peerless tenacity to advance
through the Labyrinth likely appears to #C236196003Jinako#CDEF
as a repulsive threat.

#[He][She]# is a contrast to #C236196003Jinako#CDEF, whose #C000246204SGs#CDEF have
been pulled apart, and is now completely
paralyzed by a vague fear dominating her.

Yet that's not the end of it―――
Like a cool flame, there's one thing that's
gradually scorching her mind.
―――"Her guilt, I suppose."
I murmur, to which #C236196003Karna#CDEF nods.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is trapped by a guilty conscience that
stabs at her, and regret over being abandoned
by #C236196003Monji Gatou#CDEF, whom she hates endlessly.

I'm grateful to #C236196003Gatou#CDEF.
My Master was in the depths of madness, and he
was just barely able to stop her because――

STOOPPP ITTT!
The hell, man!? Am I being publicly executed!?

Why won't you hurry your ass up and
do your Servant thing!?

I really really REALLY got the shit end of the
stick with this Servant!
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF makes her appearance.

…although, her looks never made any
claim to that title in the first place.

We gonna fight, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF?
If it'll end this, then let's do it.
There's no other choice!
No. I won't play along with your desperation.

So what then!?
You barge into people's minds for the hell
of it!? Talk about the ultimate stalker!

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF is still fixated on death.
Her survival instincts are waning beyond control.

Even if we fight, this won't turn out well―――
Win or lose, the result will be #C236196003Jinako#CDEF
being battered between her weakness and powerlessness.

Mhm. I knew you would find the words, Praetor.
It's simple and straightforward, but that's
what makes it a fantastic reply!

That's the path that will lead away from battle.
Lead to where you need to return to, where the
allies you need to depend on are.

This will be so much easier if you just
admit it. Aren't you a stubborn one?

―――Now I see.
That detail had escaped me. Certainly, one's
exploits do beget words of appreciation.

#C236196003BB#CDEF isn't forcing you to dance to her will.
Her sweet words are like wine in a lead
chalice―sweet poison that will destroy you!

Enough with being entranced with meaningless
death. Even if you gain nothing from that path,
no one will laugh at your struggle.

Not that it matters to me.
I'll use my true strength to make you submit.
After all…
You like it when it hurts, don't you?

Gratitude is given between you and the other.
If you don't put into words which part of that
man was rare, you won't understand him.

No matter what we do―――
No matter what we do,
nothing will save us!

Even if we mourn at this point, nobody's time
will turn back; not for papa or mama, not for
me, not for that annoying old man!

I won't disappear.
I won't go outside. I'll stay here forever
and ever, and IT'LL BE FINE!

Get them the HELL OUT!
Don't let them come back ever again!
WIPE THEM OFF THE FACE OF THIS EARTH!

…if that's your order, then I shall obey.
By the tyranny of my spear, I shall reduce
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF to cinders.

If the dark fire within #RUBS   you #RUBE#C236196003Jinako#CDEF#REND says it won't go
out until it burns #RUBS   you #RUBE#C236196003Jinako#CDEF#REND down, then I shall
become a mantle to block the wind and rain.

Have at you, #SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF]#.
Know that this place beds your premature death.

Have at you, #SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF]#.
Know that this place beds your premature death.

Have at you, #SVT[#C236196003Saber#CDEF][#C236196003Archer#CDEF][#C236196003Caster#CDEF][#C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF]#.
Know that this place beds your premature death.

#C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF.
Know that this place beds your premature death.

#C236196003Karna#CDEF took a full blow to the
chest from #C236196003#SVT#CDEF, yet doesn't fall.
…I shudder at the sight of his spirit, his endurance.

Yet after taking such a blow, #C236196003Karna#CDEF still stands.
It isn't due to some healing skill or immortality skill.
Incredibly, by the mere strength of his will,
he's "enduring" a fatal wound…!

What kind of monster are you? Is this some
magic, overwriting the laws of physics? Or is
your willpower deferring the laws of physics?

…do you understand what you're doing?
Do you think it's okay for one related to the
gods to be trampling over the laws of nature?

Like a zombie. He's not a Heroic spirit who
refuses to die when killed. Rather, he's a fool
prepared to not die until the time is right.

―――That's enough.
Now that I've witnessed this,
I no longer desire your head.

Not having that golden armor is regrettable,
but I see collecting it would be difficult.
…go, as you see fit and wish to.

I bet it's taking everything just for him to breathe.
#C236196003Karna#CDEF doesn't respond.

…she lost #C236196003Gatou#CDEF, and #C236196003Karna#CDEF was completely defeated.
It's evident how far backed into the corner #C236196003Jinako#CDEF is now.

But that doesn't mean we can go easy on her.
If showing her pity results in #C236196003Jinako#CDEF slipping away,
no good will have come from any of this.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is struck by a sharp blow.
The head of the immense lance smoothly slices through flesh,
annihilating the Spiritron contract linking #C236196003#SVT#CDEF―
linking #SVT[her][him][her][him]# and #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

The battle is over.
Your drive wasn't enough to make up for the
gap between your ability and mine.

…I'm also disappointed, but it is what it is.
If any more foreign bodies enter #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's mind,
it'll collapse.

Go peacefully.
I praise you two for your endeavor.

Compared to going back to that cruel
slaughter-fest, disappearing inside of me is a
hundred times better, isn't it…?
I can't hear #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's voice very well.

The lance blazes with high heat,
and my body grows cold.

Without the chance to experience pain,
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's soul burns out.

Like a something-something to a flame.
My masterful performance paid off!
I'm literally a tactician…!

Throughout the dim space,
a strangely energetic voice echoes.

It's definitely #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's voice,
but this baseless confidence,
this careless and obliviously made statement―
Was she really―――!?

#C236196003BB#CDEF-sponsored,
"Capture #C236196003#NICK#CDEF, and I'll Promote You
to Queen of the Moon Campaign."

I cleared the event,
and didn't even break a sweat.
There's nowhere to run, now, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

I turn around in the darkness,
and a distinct "mental wall" comes into view.

#C236196003Jinako#CDEF isn't joking.
This is just like back with #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF.
So, a part of #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's mind was synchronized with #C236196003BB#CDEF…!

Which means that everything that happened
up until now, and her defiance in lieu of the situation,
was all of her own accord.

What a…
What a hopeless thirty-year-old #C236196003Jinako#CDEF is…!

Let me just say this: I've done nothing wrong.
I haven't lost to anyone yet. So, I won't
be doing any self-reflecting.

And like, playing this part has been kinda fun.
Sort of feels like I'm a boss. Looking down
on peeps is the best.

I can't believe this… It's as if she feels no remorse.
Although, it's obvious that she's acting tough.

I thought #C236196003Jinako#CDEF's mind was wide-open at this point,
but it looks like it won't be so easy.
―――Guess I have to do it.

It truly pains me to do this,
but if this is how it's going to be,
then this calls for the usual rough therapy.

W-what is it?
Physical attacks do nothing here.
Nothing has any effect on me.

I got no weaknesses in the first place.
I AM the No. 1 Game Champ. I've only been
messing with 10% of my full power so far!

This "boss" has some nerve saying that,
with all the weaknesses she's got…

This is her first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
#C236196003Jinako#CDEF has a bad habit of―――
Compulsively Gigantic
Compulsively Big Breasted

What's this "compulsively gigantic" about?
A gigantic body? Being a giant?
Am I some over 180cm tall Russian beauty?

Hah. The only things allowed to be big are
